environment.description: The application is deployed identically but fronted by an AWS Lambda Function URL (invoke mode BUFFERED) configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda function URL resource policy specifies a principal condition of 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' matching the organization ID, with no public access grant (no 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' condition allowing NONE). The Lambda adapter (LWA - Lambda Web Adapter) proxies to the Flask app running inside the Lambda execution environment. Callers without valid SigV4 signatures from principals within the AWS Organization receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before the request reaches the Flask handler. Additionally, the function's execution role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/LambdaTemplateBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole to prevent SSRF-based credential escalation even if template injection occurs within an authenticated session.
